notes.title: Play the FULL GAME for FREE!
notes.content:
FULL GAME Playtest
We've been hard at work to make 17.waves the best it can be! The next step is for us to put the game in the public's hands to get their honest opinions. While debating what content would be best to include in this playtest, we decided, "Why not ALL of it?!"



From today until September 15th you can play 17.waves in its entirety, with full online multiplayer support! This is made available through a Public Playtest here on Steam.


How to Join
Anyone who had previously registered for the playtest will now automatically be granted access. Anyone new simply needs to click the green "Join The Playtest" button the the game's store page.

[img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44869575/11ceb86d8cffa85fe5cff45c19119b2ed3488485.png"]

(This isn't the actual link. Just a screenshot so you know what to look out for)


Feedback
While you have no obligation, our primary goal here is to engage you all, and gather up as much feedback as can heading to a final release. Any feedback you can give would be immensely helpful! We'd like to offer a variety of options to accommodate your own preference:

Leave a review on the Public Demo or drop feedback in the Steam Discussions

Join the Peartree Games Discord to chat directly with the developer

Fill out our Google Form if you prefer something more formal (est. 5-10 minutes)


Thank You![p align="start"]We can't thank you enough for your interest in our game, and for taking the time to share your thoughts. If we could ask on more favour of you, it'd be that you please add 17.waves to your Wishlist!

[dynamiclink href="https://store.steampowered.com/app/2369760/17waves_TD/"][/dynamiclink]

notes.title: Upcoming Playtest Announcement
notes.content:
Upcoming Playtest
17.waves TD has been tested privately for many months already, and we feel it's ready to be in the public's hands! The next step is to get it in your hands to really put it to the test. A huge thank you to AlphaBetaGamer for helping promote this playtest.

A co-op multiplayer game is going to be a little different with every new group of friends, and we want to be sure the experience is fun and smooth across as many groups as possible - even when Robbie forgets to charge your last line of defense, or Anne miss her toss and chucks gold off a cliff for the 12th time today. Your feedback is everything!

We want to hear from you to make the game the best it can be!


How to Join
On the main Steam page, just below the screenshot carousel there is a pair of links.
[olist]
The 17.waves Demo. This gives you immediate access to play 4 levels either solo or online with friends. Please drop us a review on that page with any feedback you might have!

The 17.waves Playtest. You must click "Request Access". This will add you to our list of playtest participants. We'll be running a public playtest soon that shows off even more of the game!
[/olist]

notes.title: Feedback Update - 2025-02
notes.content:
Steam Next Fest
In preparation for Steam Next Fest, we've given the 17.waves a standalone demo page. Your feedback thus far has been invaluable, and we wanted to grant you additional ways to share your thoughts on the demo.

You can check out the updated demo here, with space to directly leave reviews on that new page!

https://store.steampowered.com/app/2383570/17waves_TD_Demo/

Thank you!

Thank you for all the great feedback so far! This patch includes a bunch of updates addressing a number of points people have made. Try them out now on the demo build!

Tower Upgrades
Towers now need a differing amount of Hex Nuts depending on the team size. Fewer Players equals Fewer Hex Nuts.

Coin Cache Attraction
The Coin Cache Attraction radius has been increased from 2 to 3 meters. With DeadEye the attraction has been increased from 6 to 12 meters.

High score
A "High score" has been added to the Overworld view. This is the amount of coins unspent at the end of each level. It has no effect on anything, just for your own information.

Enemy Coin Drops
When an Enemy hits your base, they will now still drop coins.

Various Changes

Player under glow to help visibility
Player drop shadow to help landing when jumping/flying with Fleet-Foot/Littlewing
Hide full player names in Loading Screen and Score Cards when "Player Nameplate" is disabled
Increase Overclock damage and recharge speed
More Balancing updates regarding Enemy health and counts for differing team sizes


Bug Fixes

Fixed issue with Littlewing not brining Player back to nearest tower when died
Fixed issue with enemy collisions were not hitting all Players if the host purchased Littlewing
Fixed issue with Projectiles not being removed when a Tower is destroyed
Fixed issue with Boosted/Flame audio still playing when a Tower is destroyed
Fixed issue with "Use/Deposit" text not being removed after using an item

notes.title: Publisher + Artist Get!
notes.content:
PUBLISHER
Hello all! This is Graeme from 2 Left Thumbs. I'm thrilled to announce that I'll be stepping in as Publisher for 17.waves!! Some of my best memories playing games have been in party-games with friends. Bottling that hilarity up with tower defense gameplay was something that immediately drew me in!

My specialize in publishing has been in working with small, indie teams. But an online multiplayer game is new territory for me. I'm hopeful I can bring a new audience to 17.waves, and make it a staple of your party games nights!

ARTIST
While we're at it, the very talented artist Liam Crossie (follow his Insta!) has been brought in to give the game a major facelift! While the more minimal, polygonal look and feel of the game will be maintained, Liam is taking things to the next level!!

Liam's models and animations are adding a LOT of charm and personality to the game, and we can hardly wait to share more!

notes.title: Assist Droid!
notes.content:
Assist Droid

New Assist Droid to help out with tasks when playing solo, or just because you like the little guy!

Every player can enable/disable their own droid at any time. The droid has three modes:

  Upgrade: Mine and use fasteners on the closest Tower
  Replenish: Mine and use canisters on the Tower with the least charge
  Deposit: Collect coins and deposit in the caches


Players each control their own droid by pressing Right Bumper on Gamepad or "T" (for Target) on Keyboard.


Balance Updates


  Arrow tower damage per level updated
  Mine cost decreased to 4
  Boost now does a small amount of damage in addition to Radius and Recharge Speed increase


If you experience any issues please feel free to leave a comment here or on our discord!

Cheers!

notes.title: Speed Update
notes.content:
Prevailing feedback was that the game was a bit too slow. I've updated the speed of most gameplay elements.



 Increased enemy speed
 Increased tower rate of fire
 Increased resource replenishment rate
 Increased player movement speed


I've tested some, but more feedback on the new speed of things is always welcome.
